title: Essential smallness of native bounded constructible complexes
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and $X$ a Noetherian scheme. The full subcategory of the ordinary derived category of native modules having bounded adic constructible cohomology, as in [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], is essentially small in the common site/coefficient universe of [def-weil-size-convention]. This assertion is independent of any realization functor.

source.place: Native realization proof step 8 after counting sheaves: use the existing bounded-derived theorem and small Hom sets.

proof.text: Apply nativeConstructibleSheaf_essentiallySmall to the heart property. The native module category is Grothendieck abelian with small Hom sets in the site/coefficient universe, so its ordinary derived category is locally small in that universe by K-injective resolutions. The native constructible-sheaf property is isomorphism invariant. Apply the existing generic bounded-cohomology smallness theorem, then the Mathlib full-subcategory smallness instance. The boundedAdicConstructible predicate is definitionally boundedness intersected with this cohomology property.

proof_origin.place: Partition of the native realization obligation, proof steps 2--8, following Bhatt--Scholze Section 6.8; no change of the unit route.
